description: Annotations and reference marks: annotations pin a flag, pin, dot or square to a category with a label, a placement and a text the tooltip shows; referenceBands shade a range on either axis and referenceLines mark a value with an optional pill; drawings (a trend line, a rectangle, a text note) are data points that stay put through zoom and resize, drawable puts the tools in the toolbar, annotatable lets a reader pin a note on a click through onAnnotate, and tooltipSticky pins the tooltip so a note can be read. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: How do I mark an event on the chart?
faq.answer: Add an entry to annotations with at: { category }, a label, a shape (flag, pin, dot or square) and optionally a text for the tooltip and a placement for the label.

faq.question: How do I shade a period?
faq.answer: referenceBands with axis: x and from and to as categories. Without axis it shades a value range on the y axis instead.

faq.question: Can readers add their own notes?
faq.answer: Yes: annotatable adds an Annotate toggle to the toolbar; while it is on, clicking the plot fires onAnnotate with the data point, and you put it into spec.annotations. The chart owns the gesture and you own the storage.
